Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Vanta’s Customer Success Manager, Commercial you will play a pivotal role in guiding customers through their security and compliance journeys with Vanta's specialized solutions. By combining your customer-centric approach with expertise in Vanta's products and security best practices, you will contribute to the overall success and satisfaction of Vanta's customers in achieving robust security and compliance outcomes through retention of customers and health of the book of business. Vanta’s success over the last year was exponential and we are now working to solve the problem of how to provide world-class customer experience to as many security-minded software companies as possible. As Vanta’s Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will be the voice of Vanta, responsible for helping keep our customers moving toward their goals and ultimately successful and happy. What you’ll do as a Customer Success Manager, Commercial at Vanta: - Lead all post-sales activities for Vanta’s mid-market customers through onboarding, implementation, product expertise, renewal and identify upsell opportunities. - Partner with Account Managers to drive renewal and expansion opportunities within your book of business. - Act as the voice of the customer within Vanta. - Serve as the point of contact for your customers and drive them to specific business outcomes on their timelines. - Become a product expert on Vanta and how our platform can be used to improve security posture through our compliance offerings (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, USDP and Custom Frameworks), Trust Reports, and Risk Management solution. - Provide insightful technical answers and recommend the most efficient way for customers to achieve compliance using our platform. - Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors that may lead to renewals, expansion, and advocacy. - Influence Vanta’s strategy and product priorities to drive adoption and retention by being the voice of the customer. - Work cross-functionally to resolve customer business issues and work toward mutual goals. aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:93f3942d-.title: Senior Tax Manager
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:93f3942d-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:93f3942d-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE You'll build and lead the tax function at Gamma, reporting to the Director of Accounting. With tens of millions of users worldwide and a fast-growing B2B business, our tax footprint is expanding quickly across global indirect tax, income tax provision, corporate returns, and local filings. You'll be our dedicated tax owner: shaping strategy alongside the Director of Accounting, running the compliance calendar, and managing external advisors, all while staying hands-on with the technical work yourself. This is a builder's role. We keep finance lean and put automation and AI to work wherever we can, so you'll design tax processes and systems that scale with the business instead of scaling headcount. If you want to own a global tax function end-to-end, with the judgment calls, advisor relationships, and cross-functional influence that come with it, this role was built for you. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead Gamma's tax function end-to-end in partnership with the Director of Accounting, owning the global tax calendar and the relationships with our external advisors - Own global indirect tax across our self-serve and enterprise business: US sales and use tax (nexus analysis, registrations, filings) plus international VAT, GST, and digital services tax obligations - Manage the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, and review US federal, state, and local corporate income tax returns and estimated payments prepared by external advisors - Handle local and other tax obligations (franchise, property, gross receipts, business licenses), and maintain the controls, documentation, and audit support that keep the function clean - Advise on the tax implications of international expansion, entity structuring, transfer pricing, and equity compensation as Gamma grows globally - Build scalable tax processes and implement tax technology, using AI and automation to keep the function lean as complexity grows Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - An active CPA license and a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus 8+ years of progressive tax and accounting experience spanning Big Four public accounting and in-house industry roles - Deep technical command of ASC 740 tax provision, multi-state corporate income tax, and US sales and use tax compliance - Strong working knowledge of global indirect tax (VAT, GST, digital services taxes) for SaaS or digital products sold internationally - A builder's mindset: you've created tax processes, controls, and documentation from scratch and managed external advisors to get leverage - The range to operate both strategically and hands-on with limited oversight, translating complex tax issues clearly for non-tax partners, paired with genuine excitement for AI tools and a track record of automating manual work - A Master's in Taxation, experience with tax technology platforms like Anrok, Avalara, or Vertex, transfer pricing or international structuring experience, or time at a high-growth SaaS or AI company (Nice to have) COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $190K - $240K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

assistworld-assist-world:lever:10810aa8-.title: Inside Sales Agent (ISA) — Real Estate Cold Calling
assistworld-assist-world:lever:10810aa8-.description: Company Overview The clients are a two-agent real estate team built around direct lead generation rather than relying on a brokerage's referral pipeline. Client 1 works primarily as a buyer's agent with a large personal sphere of influence, while Client 2 focuses on the listing side and maintains his own book of clients in Follow Up Boss. The team invests directly in leads — including tax record data, expired and withdrawn listings, for-sale-by-owner leads, and open house leads — so they can keep more of what they earn on each deal instead of splitting it with a brokerage. Role Overview Client 1 is running lead generation and client-facing transactions largely on his own and doesn't have the bandwidth to consistently work the volume of leads coming in. This role is an Inside Sales Agent (ISA) whose sole purpose is the investment side of the business: working through roughly 840–850 existing leads sitting dormant in the team's CRM, following up on batch-purchased leads (expired, withdrawn, FSBO) and open house leads, and keeping people warm until they're ready to meet. The ISA will also spend time in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account, which holds a number of warm leads that go untouched while he's out on showings and listing appointments. Success in this role means booking qualified appointments — in person or by phone — where Client 1 or Client 2 can take over the conversation. Key Responsibilities • Make outbound calls to existing and newly purchased leads (old database leads, expired/withdrawn listings, FSBO leads, and open house leads) to re-engage and qualify them. • Follow up consistently with leads over time to keep them warm until they're ready to transact. • Gather buyer criteria on qualifying calls — target areas, price range, home style, bed/bath count, must-have amenities (e.g., proximity to a train station), and timeline. • Book appointments or phone consultations for Client 1 (and occasionally Client 2) with qualified leads, and confirm they show up. • Work leads inside the team's CRMs (HighLevel and Follow Up Boss) — logging call outcomes and moving leads through the pipeline. • Spend part of the time managing and following up on warm leads already sitting in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account. • Aim for a high volume of outbound activity — target is roughly 125–150+ calls per shift, working toward ~900 calls per week. Skills & Tools • Minimum 3–4 years of experience specifically in real estate cold calling / ISA work — general call center, pharmaceutical, or other consumer sales experience does not meet this requirement. • Comfortable working in CRMs such as HighLevel and Follow Up Boss (training available, but prior CRM fluency is a plus). • Strong phone presence — confident, personable, and persistent without being pushy. • Well organized and consistent with follow-up; able to manage a high volume of leads without letting any go cold. • Able to gather and accurately record buyer criteria and lead details. • Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable working independently once given a lead list.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:529fb7d8-1ab2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in Portugal. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability .
